---

The diagram below is adapted from `mermaid-map.md` in the repository root.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    ROOT([VizAdvisor])

    ROOT --> CFG([Config])
    ROOT --> PUB([public/])
    ROOT --> SRC([src/])
    ROOT --> SVR([server/])
    ROOT --> TST([tests/])
    ROOT --> DOC([docs/])
    ROOT --> QTO([Quarto site])

    CFG --> C1[README.md]
    CFG --> C2[package.json]
    CFG --> C3[vite.config.js]
    CFG --> C4[run.sh]
    CFG --> C5[_quarto.yml]
    CFG --> C6[styles.scss]

    SRC --> COMP([components/])
    SRC --> PAGES([pages/])
    SRC --> HOOKS([hooks/])
    SRC --> SERV([services/])
    SRC --> CTX([context/])
    SRC --> UTIL([utils/])

    COMP --> LAY[layout/]
    COMP --> INP[input/]
    COMP --> OUT[output/]
    COMP --> ANL[analysis/]
    COMP --> CMN[common/]

    SVR --> API[index.js]
    SVR --> AR[analysis/r/]
    SVR --> AP[analysis/python/]

    DOC --> D1[ARCHITECTURE.md]
    DOC --> D2[PROMPT-DESIGN.md]
    DOC --> D3[DATA-VIZ-REFERENCE.md]
    DOC --> D4[get-started.qmd]

    QTO --> Q1[index.qmd]
    QTO --> Q2[_site/]
```

## Key paths

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `src/services/promptTemplates.js` | System + user prompt assembly |
| `src/services/llmService.js` | LLM client / proxy calls |
| `src/utils/chartTypeMapper.js` | Goal → chart candidate scores |
| `src/utils/columnTypeInferrer.js` | Schema type inference |
| `src/utils/responseValidator.js` | JSON recommendation validation |
| `server/index.js` | Express `/api/recommend` + `/api/analyze` |
| `server/analysis/runner.js` | Spawns R/Python, validates I/O |
| `tests/prompts/` | Golden-path prompt fixtures |
| `docs/` | Architecture and design references |
| `index.qmd` + `_quarto.yml` | This Posit documentation site |

See also [Directory Structure](STRUCTURE.md).
